status: frozen before any prototype arm has trained; written while the single-channel attribution sweep was 17/55 cells in (fixed/off/lucid_rg/s4_rg friction+mass marginals seen), which is disclosed here rather than hidden
question: Given a policy that has already mastered the lambda=1 envelope, how should support be widened in a fixed 2,000-iteration budget, and does a per-channel (vector) frontier buy anything a scalar frontier does not?

design.origin_description: fixed DR, seed 8600, 8,000 from-scratch iterations; the arm every controller arm is compared with in the ne1024 campaign
design.warm_start: non-resume: policy weights only; fresh optimizer, LR schedule and iteration counter for every arm alike

arms.fixed_150: lambda 1.5 from iteration 0, single stratum (width control)
arms.ramp_150: 8 strata; frontier linear 1.0->1.5 over iterations 0-1500; reads nothing
arms.gate_150: 8 strata; scalar frontier stepped +0.125 when the 128-env probe one step above it averages >=0.80 time-out over a 100-iteration window (dwell 50, min 200 episodes); freeze-only guard
arms.box_150: identical to gate_150 except the frontier is a vector over the six runtime-scalable terms; the single probe visits channels round-robin; channel_budget 300

design.why_the_ceiling_is_shared: so the primary endpoint and every channel marginal at 2.0/3.0 lie outside every arm's training support; the box can differ only in which channels widen and when

secondary_channel_panel.reading: per-channel signature: an arm that widened channel c more should gain on ch_c cells; reported per channel, never pooled into a single number for a decision

noise: paired within-seed SD on the two-cell band measured at 2.74 points (Phase 0); one seed screens, it does not decide

decision_rules.R1_box_vs_gate: delta = primary(box_150) - primary(gate_150). |delta| < 0.03: no scalar-vs-vector difference at this budget; the box is not pursued on this evidence. delta >= +0.03: the box advances to one from-scratch 8,000-iteration cell against gate_150. delta <= -0.03: the box is shelved and its frontier_vector trace is diagnosed offline; it is NOT re-run with a lower threshold.
decision_rules.R2_gate_vs_ramp: informational only at this budget; the Phase 2 from-scratch screen owns that contrast
decision_rules.R3_monotonicity: any applied decrease in lambda or in any channel of frontier_vector is an incident; the count must be zero for every arm
decision_rules.R4_box_mechanism: the box must have visited >= 3 distinct channels and fired >= 1 expansion within 2,000 iterations; otherwise it is reported as STALLED, diagnosed offline from its curriculum jsonl, and not counted as a loss
decision_rules.R5_width: if fixed_150 >= max(gate_150, box_150, ramp_150) + 0.03 on the primary endpoint, width without scheduling wins at this budget and that is reported as the headline

not_claimed: superiority of any arm on one seed
motion generalization (single clip, fresh physics only)
